name: Lani the Merthropologist
summary:
Lani is a shy archivist working at the Museum of Merthropology. One day, she is forced out of the stacks and into the light for her very first expedition...exploring the mysterious Palace of Corel...
This game is what I like to call a "jawbone" mystery game (named after the book, Cain's Jawbone). The story is told through the environment and found artifacts, and it is up to the player to discover each object and interpret the truth. The puzzles aren't too difficult, but there is a good amount of information to parse through. In order to slip into Lani's fins, you are encouraged to take notes on everything you see. It may even be fun to play this game with a friend!
